items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And he played all of these and he talked to me. I just decided then that I wanted to play trumpet, not piano.

ctx.x: Right, right. Sure. And they had a trumpet player named Bob Russel that I was crazy about because he had, when he opened his case, when he opened his case there was a slide trumpet, a mellophone a French Horn, a Catch trumpet which is about four feet long and a conventional trumpet. And he played all of these and he talked to me. I just decided then that I wanted to play trumpet, not piano.

So I got my dad to get me a little cornet. I had a little cornet and I practiced on it. That was my first horn until Christmas came and they got me a Buescher. My mother brought me a Buescher. So we played it.
